summary.title: Threat Model for Fintech Core Banking
summary.description: Generated by OmniSec unified product security pipeline with STRIDE/LINDDUN analysis.

threats.title: Client Identity Spoofing & Broken Auth Token Validation
threats.description: Adversary sends forged JWTs or replayed credentials to bypass identity verification.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict RS256/ES256 asymmetric signature verification, short-lived tokens, and jti revocation list.

threats.title: Data Tampering via Unparameterized Input or Missing State Integrity
threats.description: Untrusted parameters injected into application layer alter database records or transactions.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict ORM parameterized queries, row-level integrity checks, and least-privilege DB credentials.

threats.title: Insufficient Audit Trail for Critical Actions & State Transitions
threats.description: Sensitive administrative changes, balance transfers, or permission grants occur without immutable logging.
threats.mitigation: Implement structured tamper-evident security logging with user IDs, timestamps, client IPs, and append-only log sinks.

threats.title: Sensitive Data Leakage via Error Stack Traces and Verbose Headers
threats.description: Production endpoints return unhandled exception stack traces, environment variables, or database schemas.
threats.mitigation: Sanitize all error responses, disable debug mode in production, and remove Server/X-Powered-By banners.

threats.title: Application Resource Exhaustion via Unthrottled Endpoints (API4)
threats.description: Expensive queries, file uploads, or cryptographic hashing endpoints lack rate limiting and concurrency caps.
threats.mitigation: Implement IP and token-based rate limiting (e.g. token bucket in Redis), strict request body size limits, and timeouts.

threats.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR)
threats.description: Endpoint does not verify if the requesting authenticated user owns or has rights to the requested resource ID.
threats.mitigation: Implement centralized context-aware authorization checks on every data access query (e.g. user_id = current_user.id).
